title: Great Pyramid as a transmitter

tellings.quote: transmitter okay M of signal whatever they want to whoever they want to talk to

plain: A researcher named Joe McMoneagle, speaking in 2025 on the show of podcast host Jesse Michels, suggests that the Great Pyramid at Giza in Egypt worked as a transmitter. As he puts it, its users could send a signal of whatever they wanted to whoever they wanted to talk to. If true, it would mean the ancient Egyptians had a way to send messages over great distances.
